ai.text: The Youth Poisoning Protection Act would ban consumer products that contain sodium nitrite at a concentration of 10% or higher, treating them as banned hazardous products. The ban does not cover certain drugs, medical devices, cosmetics, or food products.

summary.label: Congressional Research Service, Introduced in Senate
summary.text:
Youth Poisoning Protection Act
This bill makes a consumer product with a concentration of sodium nitrite of 10% or greater a banned hazardous product.
The restriction does not apply to specified drugs, medical devices, cosmetics, or food products.
